title: Modification of Minimum Size of Loading Berth
previewText: For all permitted or required accessory loading berths, the minimum length requirements for uses in LRC-A, set forth in Sections 36-661 (Size of required berths) and 44-561 (Size of required berths), shall be 37 feet.
